grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'Had' as a condition
explanation: After the inverted 'Had', the main clause needs a conditional perfect to describe what would have happened under an unreal past condition. Polish speakers may default to a simple tense here, because Polish conditional forms are built differently from English ones.
